messages.text: Not so sure about this though, speed and l2 should be a focus yes i agree but imho number of functional apps is low
I am just another Alex
What is purpose of speed without a car
Im talking about dapps
Better to have 5 great super fast dapps or 20 great not so fast dapps?
Genuine question here
Is it a real question?
I think a few dapps bringing added value to broader non finance people would be nice too (the fiverr equivalent working with LETS suggested by @glasgowm is a good example) would be nice to have too
And yes interfaces improvements would be good too
I feel like, from just looking at the evolution of the ecosystem as an outside observer, consistency is often lacking
Either because dapps are developed as side projects
Done during free time with people getting in and out of projects
And no real dedicated teams
Either because people get demotivated due to lack of people interacting with it
Or because the service they offer is not super necessary
Yes, i guess the incentives are just too low

This is less a dapp idea and more a financial thing, would it be already possible to create indexes of blockchains dapps using oracles? For example an index of all defis token dapps of ethereum or index of all nfts token dapps of Solana but invest in the index through Ergo? 
The equivalent of MSCI indexes but in the blockchain realm
Ah wow super interesting, did not know it existed
Also non-financial dapp idea would be a skillshare platform for devs based on Ergo
Could also use LETS payment method

Yes, you get paid in LETS if people buy your course and you can pay in lets if you want to access courses, ofc you would then need to convert through a dex to get the lets. This dapp could easily expand to the idea that @glasgowm shared in the general channel, a place in which you can pay in LETS people that build things for you (graphic designers, product designers, developers…) could also become a nice marketplace to find resources that can help you build your dapps while incentivise people to do so. Although LETS is not an absolute necessity, paying people in whatever stablecoin could also be an option

I could work on this, i just need some devs willing to help, one frontend and one backend. 
I would do the ux and the ui and prepare the design tokens and component ui kit for the front end
